courseName: Master of Social and Community Leadership
nextStartDates: 2027 Semester One – 1 March, 2027 Semester Two – 19 July

additionalRequirements.qualification: A relevant professional qualification, equivalent to a Bachelors degree of at least 360 points, with at least two years of relevant professional experience
If you don’t meet the GPE requirement you can still gain entry by passing 60 points towards the Postgraduate Certificate in Social and Community Leadership with a GPA of 5 or higher
